title: Cosmic Eye Lanterns
description: A surreal night scene featuring a giant cosmic eye in the sky shaped like a swirling purple galaxy with a black hole pupil and glowing rings. In the foreground, a large glowing lantern sits on a mossy ledge beside a fish-like creature holding a smaller lantern, surrounded by glowing mushrooms, vines, and sparkling magical particles.
prompt: Surreal fantasy night scene with a massive cosmic eye dominating the purple swirling galaxy sky, the eye formed from a glowing black hole with bright accretion disk and orbiting rings. In the foreground on a mossy cliff edge, a large ornate glowing lantern stands beside a fish creature walking upright while holding a smaller lantern, surrounded by bioluminescent mushrooms, twisting vines, and sparkling golden particles under a starry sky.
